name: 70301 · Thibodaux, LA
findings: ZIP 70301 (Thibodaux) has 127 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70301 (Thibodaux) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 70301 (Thibodaux) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 57 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
